newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia airport corp net profit up 14.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia airport corp net profit up 14.5 pct.

text.p: Australia's Federal Airports Corp (FAC) said on Tuesday it achieved a net profit of A$78.1 million in the year to June 30, 1996, up 14.5 percent on the previous year.
The FAC, in its annual report released on Tuesday, also forecast another positive result from its operations in the current financial year.
The FAC said operating profit rose 25 percent to a record A$160.4 million, while passenger volumes grew 7.3 percent and revenue gained 14.6 percent to A$579.3 million.
"Once again, the biggest contribution to the profit performance was by our primary airports," chairman Ian Ferrier said in the report.

Ferrier said Sydney airport, accounting for more than half of the operating profit, had started to realise dividends from the significant investment in terminal and runway facilities over the past few years. Its profit before interest and tax rose 32.5 percent to A$91 million.
